"PREMIER PLAY" offers a top prize of $3 million and ten prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

The most common prize left on "PREMIER PLAY" right now is $100.

Everything above about "PREMIER PLAY" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2414.headline: Same price, different prizes

2415.body:
"Double The Money" has 175,720 prizes of $10 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $2,000 prize, with two left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If you play "Double The Money" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2415.headline: What's actually left to win

2416.body:
"Loaded with $2,000s" has 1,087 of 3,372 top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About two-thirds of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

The table below shows the full count for "Loaded with $2,000s", with every prize level included.
2416.headline: Where this game is in its run

2419.body:
"Bronze 7s" has one of four top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes and the tickets are going at about the same pace.

If "Bronze 7s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2419.headline: Where this game is in its run

2420.body:
"Silver 7s" has two of three top prizes left and is about halfway through its run. About half of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Today's free summary of "Silver 7s" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2420.headline: How far along this game is

2421.body:
"Gold 7s" has gone over a month without a top prize claim, and tickets kept selling. Only a fixed number of tickets are printed. About a third of the tickets are sold, and every remaining $577,777 prize is still unclaimed. That leaves the same top prizes among fewer tickets.

Everything above about "Gold 7s" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2421.headline: Top prizes are still left

2422.body:
About half of the tickets for "Platinum 7s" are sold. The top prize count has held, with two of three still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

The numbers for "Platinum 7s" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2422.headline: No new top prize claims

2425.body:
"$1,000,000 Crossword Gems" is new from the Virginia Lottery. It is a $20 game with three top prizes of $1 million. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

Everything here about "$1,000,000 Crossword Gems" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 26.
2425.headline: New game, all prizes left

2426.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS", about a third are still unsold. The game is well into its run, with 1,854 of 5,340 top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The table below shows the full count for "HAUNTED HUNDREDS", with every prize level included.
2426.headline: Early stage or late

2427.body:
"HOLIDAY TRIPLER" has 463 of 602 top prizes left and is early in its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets and top prizes are running out at about the same rate.

Everything above about "HOLIDAY TRIPLER" comes from the Virginia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
2427.headline: How much has sold

2428.body:
"PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" has five of five top prizes left and is near the start of its run. About a quarter of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

If "PEPPERMINT PAYOUT" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2428.headline: Tickets sold so far

2429.body:
"MERRY MONEY TREE" is down to three top prizes after a $125,000 winner was claimed over a week ago. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

Every line of MERRY MONEY TREE's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2429.headline: Someone claimed a $125,000 prize

2430.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "WRAPPED IN RICHES", most is in wins under $2,000. The game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

If you play "WRAPPED IN RICHES" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
2430.headline: Where the prize money is

2431.body:
"2027" just went on sale in Virginia. The game has ten full prize levels with four top prizes of $2,027. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

Everything here about "2027" comes from official Virginia lottery numbers, current through November 26.
2431.headline: New in stores

2433.body:
"Black Ice" just reached Virginia stores with three top prizes of $500,000. A new game is the easiest kind to judge. No prizes have been claimed, and the overall odds are accurate for now. Every day of sales changes that, and this page tracks it.

Today's free summary of "Black Ice" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2433.headline: A new game is here

2434.body:
"Loaded with $250s" has joined the Virginia lineup at $5 with 11,082 top prizes of $250. Only on the first day do the overall odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

Every line of Loaded with $250s's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
2434.headline: A brand-new game to watch
